title: Progress
summary: A long job as a person sees it, in one of three looks (C34): full -- title and state badge, the overall bar with «N из M · %» and the time left, the counts as one line, the first errors, the steps with states, times and a log each, Pause/Continue, Cancel, Minimize, and once ended the summary with Retry and Hide; compact -- a table row's bar or badge; notice -- a corner panel's row. The host drives it; it polls nothing.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

look.description: The look (owner decision C34): full -- the card: title with the state badge, the overall bar with «N из M · %» and the time left, the counts, the first errors, the steps with a log each, the actions; it is also the summary once the job ended. compact -- one line for a table row: a thin bar with «62 % · 3 мин» while it runs, the state badge once it stopped, icon actions. notice -- one row for a corner panel: the ring in the icon field, the name, a line of figures and Expand. The data are the same in every look; the host changes look (minimize, expand). Named look, not view: view is a name the element runtime keeps for itself

label.description: The job's name as a person says it («Импорт товаров из «Прайс_ноябрь.xlsx»»): the title (a heading of heading-level) and the region's name. Without it the region is named «Ход выполнения» / «Progress» and the full look has no title line

heading-level.description: The title's heading level in the page outline (h1-h6), 3 by default. Semantics only: the title is drawn at the run's rung text line, semibold, whatever the level (C34, R082), so it follows density and the phone ladder

caption.description: A line under the title: where and when («Каталог «Электроника» · запущено в 14:02»). Plain text

value.description: How much is done, in units of total (4812). With total the overall bar is determinate and the figures read «4 812 из 12 000 товаров · 40 %»; without total the bar runs (indeterminate) and the figure reads the count so far

total.description: How much there is (12000). Unset or 0: the size is not known yet and the bar runs; once set the same bar fills, once (C34)

unit.description: The word of the figures, its plural forms separated by | in the order of the page language's plural categories (ru: «товар|товара|товаров», en: «item|items»); one form is used for all

remaining.description: The time left in milliseconds, when the host knows it. Without it the run works it out from the rate of value, hidden until the rate settles (5 s of change) and always rounded up («осталось ≈ 6 мин», «меньше минуты»)

started-at.description: When the job started (ISO 8601): the elapsed time while the size is unknown, and «заняло 8:08» once it ended. Without it the run counts from the moment it first saw the job run

finished-at.description: When the job ended (ISO 8601), for a summary a server prints: «заняло» is finished-at − started-at

run-state.description: The job's state (the name state is the element base's own). auto works it out from the steps: failed when one failed, running while one runs, done when every step is done or skipped (partial when errors-total or an error counter is above 0), else waiting (drawn as queued). paused: the host stopped the job and will go on -- a warning badge and bar. partial: it finished with errors -- a warning badge and bar, never success. cancelled: the host stopped it for good -- neutral

result-text.description: The result in words once the job ended: «Сайт создан» on success, the reason on a failure («Не хватает места на диске»), what to do on partial. Without it the result says «Готово», «Готово с ошибками», «Не удалось» or «Отменено»

errors-total.description: How many errors the job had in all (40). Above the errors shown, «Ещё 35 ошибок» sends report; above 0 an auto run that finished is partial

output.description: The output so far, as plain text (a server prints it); the action chunk appends to it. Drawn monospace, never as markup

output-label.description: The output pane's toggle; «Вывод» / «Output» when not set

file-name.description: The name the output is saved under by the download button

cancelable.description: Shows Cancel while the job runs; its press asks cancel

pausable.description: Shows Pause while the job runs and Continue while it is paused; their presses send pause and resume. Only where the host can really pause the job (C34)

retryable.description: Shows Retry after a failure, a cancel or a partial result; its press sends retry {scope, from?}: «Повторить неудачные» (scope failed) on partial, «Повторить» (scope all, from the failed step) on a failure

hideable.description: Shows Hide once the job ended; its press asks close

minimizable.description: Shows Minimize in the full look; its press sends minimize, and the host shows the notice look (a corner panel is the page's composition)

size.description: The ladder rung: a step's title is the rung's line, its text, time and the output the rung below's, a one-line step the rung's control height. 1/2 for a narrow drawer

output-open.description: The output pane is open. A person opens and closes it with its toggle; a page may open it (a failure, say). The pane follows the newest line only while the reader is at its end

steps.description: The job's steps in order, each {id, title, state waiting|running|done|failed|skipped, text?, value?, total?, unit?, log?, started?, finished?, duration?}. A property, or the JSON island a server prints; the host sets the whole list again or changes one step with the action step. Time per step: duration in milliseconds, else finished − started (ISO 8601), and a running step with started counts up each second. An unknown state reads as waiting. value and total give a step its own figures («18 240 из 42 600 файлов»), written before its text; log is the step's own log so far as plain text (a server prints it), and chunk({text, step}) appends to it

counters.description: The result counts as one line of text in tabular figures: «Добавлено 9 227 · Обновлено 2 755 · 18 ошибок». Each {id, label, value, status?, zero?}: the label followed by the value, or with {n} where the number stands; plural forms separated by | («{n} ошибка|{n} ошибки|{n} ошибок»). A counter at 0 is left out; a status error counter at 0 shows its zero words (zero, «ошибок нет») in the quiet colour once the job ended. Only a non-zero error count is coloured, and it is a link that sends report

errors.description: The first errors of the job, each {where?, key?, text}: where it happened (a row «218»), what (an article «TV-55-QL»), and why. The first 5 are shown in the summary; errors-total says how many there are

chunk.summary: Appends text to the output: chunk({text, step?}), the object form of vocabulary §5.2 chunk {id, text} of a stream (a rule hands a job's output chunk on); a plain string, chunk(text), is accepted as shorthand. With step the text goes to that step's own log (its row opens it; a failed step's log is open by itself); without step to the run's output. A line break ends a line; the pane follows the new text only while the reader is at its end. Refused {reason: invalid} for no text, {reason: missing} for a step the run does not have

clear.summary: Empties the output (a job started again)

step.summary: Changes one step: the fields given replace that step's (state, text, value, total, started, finished, duration). Refused {reason: missing} for an id the run does not have

sf-progress-run-cancel.summary: A person pressed Cancel while the job ran (vocabulary §5 cancel). A request: the host stops the job and sets state cancelled (or the failed step); the component changes nothing by itself

sf-progress-run-retry.summary: A person pressed Retry (vocabulary §5 retry): {scope: failed} after a partial result -- only what failed; {scope: all, from?} after a failure (from: the failed step's id) or a cancel. The host starts the job again and sets the steps anew

sf-progress-run-close.summary: A person pressed Hide once the job ended (vocabulary §5 close). A request: not cancelled, the host removes the run or closes the drawer it stands in; the component does not hide itself

sf-progress-run-download.summary: A person pressed the download button of the output (vocabulary §5 download). Not cancelled, the browser saves the output as plain text under file-name; a page that keeps the full log cancels it and serves its own file

sf-progress-run-toggle.summary: The output pane was opened or closed by its toggle: the fact after the change, {open}

sf-progress-run-pause.summary: A person pressed Pause while the job ran (pausable). A request: the host pauses the job and sets run-state paused; the component changes nothing by itself

sf-progress-run-resume.summary: A person pressed Continue while the job was paused (pausable). A request: the host goes on and sets run-state running

sf-progress-run-minimize.summary: A person pressed Minimize in the full look (minimizable). A request: the host shows the notice look, in its own corner panel

sf-progress-run-expand.summary: A person pressed Expand in the notice look. A request: the host shows the full look (in a drawer or in place)

sf-progress-run-report.summary: A person asked for the errors: the error count link or «Ещё N ошибок». Not cancelled, the count link moves to the error list shown in the summary; the host serves the full report (a file, a page)

forbidden_client_responsibilities: polling the job (the host sets the steps and appends the output)
running, cancelling or retrying the job (the host answers cancel and retry)
deciding that a job ended (the host sets the steps or state)

keyboard: Tab reaches the error link, the step logs, the output toggle, the output, copy, download and the actions in order
Enter or Space presses a button; Enter follows the error link
accessibility.focus: The run never takes focus by itself.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-progress-run for a long job a person started and waits for: creating a site, an update, a backup or a restore, an import, a publish, a package install.
do_not: Do not poll from the component; the host sets the steps and appends the output with chunk
Do not use it for one value of progress; sf-progress-bar does that
Do not render markup in the output; it is plain text
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-progress-run label="Импорт товаров" total="12000" value="4812" unit="товар|товара|товаров" pausable cancelable></sf-progress-run>
